verdict.rationale: The MoQ Relay documents low-latency publish/subscribe media streaming with scoped tokens. A developer could build their own subscriber that forwards audio to a transcription or realtime model. That is only a building block, though: the pack documents no feature for routing live session audio to an AI or transcription endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, live session audio can be streamed to a transcription or realtime model endpoint while the session is running

citations.quote: It provides efficient, low-latency media streaming by leveraging QUIC's multiplexing and connection management capabilities.
Cloudflare returns a relay ID and two default tokens: one that can publish and subscribe, and one that can only subscribe.
